groups.directions:
Topic: Cloze Test
Subtopic: Traditional Cloze

PASSAGE 1
The global transition towards renewable energy has fundamentally (1)_______ the geopolitical landscape. Nations that once relied heavily on importing fossil fuels are now heavily investing in solar and wind infrastructure to achieve unprecedented energy (2)_______. This shift, however, is not without its (3)_______. The manufacturing of solar panels and wind turbines requires massive quantities of rare earth metals, the mining of which often causes severe environmental (4)_______ in developing nations. Furthermore, the intermittent nature of solar and wind power necessitates the rapid development of advanced, grid-scale battery storage (5)_______ to ensure a stable and consistent power supply during peak demand hours.

questions.text: Choose the correct word for blank (1).
questions.explanation: A transition to renewable energy changes or "restructures" the geopolitical landscape, rather than preserving or ignoring it.

questions.text: Choose the correct word for blank (2).
questions.explanation: Nations investing in their own solar and wind infrastructure do so to stop relying on imports, thereby achieving energy "independence".

questions.text: Choose the correct word for blank (3).
questions.explanation: The phrase "is not without its..." usually introduces a negative aspect following a positive one. The next sentence discusses environmental damage, making "challenges" the correct choice.

questions.text: Choose the correct word for blank (4).
questions.explanation: Mining rare earth metals is known to cause severe environmental damage or "degradation".

questions.text: Choose the correct word for blank (5).
questions.explanation: Advanced battery storage refers to "technologies" developed to ensure a stable power supply.
